errors.evidence: The segments are not arranged in descending order. The order of percentages, starting from the 12 o'clock position and moving clockwise, is 9.3%, 2.2%, 2.3%, 10.4%, 22.2%, 24.3%, 29.3%. This is not a descending sequence.
